City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA

6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.

3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation on the Enterprise Workflow Management System, EnerGov by Acting IT Applications Supervisor Van Pelt
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (45 MINUTES)
For this meeting, the Mayor will allow 45 minutes of Oral Communications and any additional Oral Communications will be heard after all agendized items have been considered. Each speaker will be allowed two (2) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a â€œPINKâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2017-09-27 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
An amendment to the existing Civic Solutions, Inc. contract agreement for additional Planner support in Fiscal Year 2017-18 for professional planning services in the amount of $89,000 to support planning application processing and other planning functions, allowing regular staff to focus on implementation of the EnerGov enterprise workflow management system. Contact Person: Principal Planner Kusiak
1) Authorize the City Manager to amend the current contract agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc., adding an additional $89,000 to the contract, for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $216,000.
2017-09-27 Item 08B Civic Solutions
8C.
Legislative Position Letters. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the legislative position letters, as signed by the Mayor.
2017-09-27 Item 08C Legislative Position Letters
8D.
Contract for Annual Street Sweeping Services. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
Authorize the Purchasing Authority to amend the original October 9, 2013, contract with Cannon Pacific Sweeping for additional parking lot sweeping for Encinitas Community Park. The additional Park Sweeping Services would be an annual increase of $1,560 for a total not to exceed the annual budgeted amount.
2017-09-27 Item 08D Street Sweeping Contract
8E.
Amendment to Agreement with HDR, Inc. for Chesterfield Drive Rail Quiet Zone Processing As Part of the Verdi-Montgomery Avenue Vicinity Pedestrian Rail Crossing Project (CS16E). Contact Person: Interim Deputy City Engineer Zaino
Authorize the Director of Development Services, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to an existing agreement with HDR Engineering, Inc. in the amount of $108,000, plus 15% contingencies, to obtain California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) and Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) approval to establish a rail quiet zone beginning at Chesterfield Drive as part of the Verdi-Montgomery Avenue Vicinity Pedestrian Rail Crossing Project (CS16E), for a total contract amount not to exceed $750,225.
2017-09-27 Item 08E Final Montgomery At-Grade HDR Contract Amendment Ave to X Drive
8F.
As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreements. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
1) City Council authorize the City Manager to execute the As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreement for City Parks, Beaches, Trails and Facilities with Design Builders for an initial three-year term and authorize the City Manager to extend the contract for one (1) three-year renewal option upon satisfactory performance and mutual agreement for a six year total not to exceed $364,500; 2) City Council authorize the City Manager to execute the As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreement for City Parks, Beaches, Trails and Facilities with Geo Tech Construction Inc. for an initial three-year term and authorize the City Manager to extend the contract for one (1) three-year renewal option upon satisfactory performance and mutual agreement for a six year total not to exceed $244,215; and 3) City Council authorize the City Manager to execute the As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreement for City Parks, Beaches, Trails and Facilities with Urban Corps of San Diego County for an initial three-year term and authorize the City Manager to extend the contract for one (1) three-year renewal option upon satisfactory performance and mutual agreement for a six year total not to exceed $191,363.
2017-09-27 Item 08F As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreements
8G.
Rejection of Bids for City of Encinitas Institutional Fiber Optic Communications Network Project. Contact Person: IT Supervisor Labarrere
Reject all bids and authorize staff to re-bid the construction of the Cityâ€™s Institutional Fiber Optic Communications Network.
2017-09-27 Item 08G IT Fiber Communications Project - Reject All Bids
8H.
Director of Finance/City Treasurer Classification Salary Adjustment. Contact Person: Human Resources Analyst Chase
Staff recommends that the City Council approve Resolution 2017-91 approving a salary adjustment for the Director of Finance/City Treasurer classification.
2017-09-27 Item 08H Director of Finance Salary Adjustment
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Presentation, review and discussion on the first draft Alternatives of the Coastal Mobility & Livability Study (CMLS) related to the Coastal Business Districts Parking Study and the Rail Corridor Vision Study, and authorization for additional expenditures, within the existing budget, in a not-to-exceed amount of $23,600 (RCVS/$10,000; Parking Study/$3,600; ATP/$10,000) to allow for consultant preparation and attendance at additional meetings. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Receive the report and provide input on the first draft alternatives of the CMLS specific to the parking study and the rail crossings; 2) Authorize additional expenditures, within the existing budget, in a not-to-exceed amount of $23,600 (RCVS/$10,000; Parking Study/$3,600; ATP/$10,000) to allow for consultant preparation and attendance at additional meetings; and 3) Provide staff direction, as deemed appropriate.
2017-09-27 Item 10A CMLS First Draft Alternatives

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
